summary: Iteration 3 testing complete: validated /api/customers aggregation+RBAC scoping, Customers page UI, Bookings CSV export, and printable Invoice page. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_customers.py (auth-required, aggregation across multi-branch same-phone, total_bookings/total_rental/total_advance_paid sums, outstanding_to_collect/refund excludes Returned, last_booking_date is max, branch_ids contains every branch, bookings list shape matches contract, search case-insensitive on name+phone, super_admin sees all + branch_id filter limits to only that branch's bookings even for a multi-branch customer, manager scoped to own branch — KLN customers invisible, regression sanity on /branches /bookings /users /auth/me /stats/dashboard all green). Frontend: all critical flows pass for super_admin and manager — nav-customers visible to ALL roles, /customers loads with customers-page + customers-search-input, customers-branch-filter shows for super_admin and hides for manager, view-customer-<phone> opens customer-detail-dialog with bookings list linking to /invoice/<id>. Bookings page: export-csv-button triggers a real download (bookings-YYYY-MM-DD.csv with all 18 expected headers including Bill No, Branch, Product Code, Product Name, Customer Name, Customer Phone, Customer Address, ID Proof, Booking/Delivery/Return Date, Rental Amount, Total Advance, Advance Paid, Customer To Be Paid, Refund To Customer, Status, Notes). invoice-booking-<bill_no> per row navigates to /invoice/:id which renders invoice-page with invoice-branch-name, invoice-bill-no, invoice-print, invoice-back, the 'Rental balance (Rental − Advance Paid)' row, and Authorised Signature footer. invoice-back returns to /bookings. Unauthenticated /invoice/:id correctly redirects to /login.

issues: Carry-over from iter 2: React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' is printed in console. Originates from emergent dev-tool x-* wrappers injected around dynamic <option> children, not from app code. Non-blocking, but worth muting in dev wrapper or replacing native <select> with a shadcn Select to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_customers(): aggregation is O(N) over up to 10000 bookings in Python — fine for current scale; consider a $group MongoDB pipeline if booking volume grows past 10k.

Customers.jsx: customer detail dialog uses Link inside table-like list which still triggers full SPA navigation — works, but for super_admin viewing from /customers, hitting Back from /invoice returns to /customers (correct). No issue.

Invoice.jsx: when booking has no branch_id (legacy BILL-0001) the branch fields fall back to 'Branch' string and address/phone are blank — acceptable; just be aware printed invoice shows generic header for legacy rows.
Bookings.jsx handleExportCSV exports the current filtered list (search + status + branch filter all applied server-side via /bookings query). This matches spec.
lib/csv.js: properly BOM-prefixes UTF-8, escapes commas/quotes/newlines — good.
Carry-overs from iter 1/2 still open: deprecated @app.on_event lifecycle hooks, CORS '*' with allow_credentials=True, /branches /users now have RoleRoute guards (iter2 action item resolved).
